# MediaDock Next

Before changing anything under `next/`, read the [AI documentation index](../../next/docs/ai/README.md) first and follow its task-specific references. The [local runbook](../../next/README.md) is the operations entrypoint; the root app, Python backend, Firebase/Firestore, Google Auth, and GitHub Pages apps are separate from this runtime.
